metadata.title: Field Operations: Loading & Unloading Dedicated Interfaces

actions: Project selection scoped to operator project assignments
Authorized carrier quick-selection card (filtered by project)
Active truck card selection (filtered by carrier relationship)
Active driver card selection (filtered by carrier relationship)
Authorized material selection (filtered by project)
Tare weight capture via large digital input, presets (8.2t, 13.8t, 14.2t, 15t), and scale-in simulation button
Gross weight capture via large digital input, presets (42t, 45.6t, 49.8t), and scale-out simulation button
Step micro-adjusters (+/- 100 kg, +/- 500 kg) for touch screens
Real-time client net display (Gross - Tare) in kg and metric tons
Axle & regulatory limits check (General Transport Authority 35t net / 50t gross thresholds)
Blocking validation on gross <= tare, missing entities, or expired pricing rules
Read-only settlement preview enforcing server pricing calculation authority
Dominant 52px touch CTA: 'Confirm & Dispatch Trip Ticket'
Creation of trip in LOADED status with immediate transition to IN_TRANSIT
Offline fallback to IndexedDB and Outbox queue when offline
Thermal weighbridge ticket presentation with QR/barcode placeholder
Print and copy actions
One-touch 'Next Truck' reset preserving station context
Rapid search by Trip Serial or Ticket ID
Prohibition of ambiguous bare-plate search
Inbound In-Transit queue selector allowing one-touch truck acquisition with zero typing
Dual-scale mode (Destination Gross - Destination Tare)
Direct Net mode with quick adjustment touch controls (+/- 100 kg, +/- 500 kg)
Simulation presets for acceptable shrinkage (-150 kg) and out-of-tolerance (-2,500 kg)
Server-side calculation of varianceWeight = destNetWeight - originNetWeight
Tolerance threshold calculation: max(toleranceKg, originNet * tolerancePercent / 100)
High-visibility status gauge (Green: Within Tolerance, Red: Out of Tolerance)
State progression: IN_TRANSIT -> ARRIVED -> UNLOADING -> COMPLETED
Explicit 'Accept origin net as destination' button with documented audit reason
Completion triggers automatic TripExceptionEntity if variance exceeds tolerance threshold
Digital destination receipt with verified variance stamp
Detailed exception advisory banner when variance is flagged
Immediate queue refresh for the next arriving vehicle

explicitOriginNetAcceptance.mechanism: User-triggered action setting destNetWeight = originNetWeight with variance 0 kg and audited reason string

phone.layout: Single-column vertical stack, 48px+ touch targets, dominant primary action button

tablet.layout: Optimized 2-column workstation (Entity identification on left, Scale capture & actions on right)

desktop.layout: Full operational workstation with expanded manifest queue, live scale readouts, and ticket inspection
